# Stata packages vendored in .stata/ado/plus (committed).
#
# No version numbers here, deliberately. SSC has no versioned install -- `ssc
# install estout 3.1.2` is a syntax error, not a version request -- so a version
# in this file could not be enforced by anything, and the rule that read one
# printed "with version 3.1.2" while installing whatever SSC served that day.
#
# Versions live in stata-requirements.txt, generated from what is actually
# installed and verified by `make stata-check`.
#
# The ado files themselves are committed, per AEA Data Editor guidance: "provide
# copies of such packages/modules when the package repository does not allow you
# to specify a version." `make stata-env` therefore installs nothing when they
# are present; use `make stata-update` to refresh from SSC deliberately.
#
# `require` is listed because stata-check and stata-requirements both use it.
reghdfe
ftools
estout
coefplot
require
